decisions.reason: As a low-cost accelerator program with high uncertainty about which startups will emerge, it is a valuable option that remains inexpensive to keep open.

The bio-based binder is more distant from core machinery and has high technical uncertainty, but the firm's continued dedicated page suggests the option is still worth keeping while costs are manageable.

The infectious waste plant is close to the firm's established modular recycling technology and prominently featured, making it a high-value option that warrants continued investment despite capital intensity.
